name: glyhub_GPST000647_N
title: Whole-brain N-glycans in Slc35a3-deficient mice
description: N-glycan amounts in whole-brain tissue from wild-type, heterozygous and Slc 35 a 3-knockout mice, with three source observations per genotype.
details: The 179 rows include paucimannose, high-mannose, hybrid, neutral-complex and acidic-complex features. Paucimannose counts are literal; other source counts describe residues beyond the Hex 3 HexNAc 2 N-glycan core. Full compositions include this core, consistent with the reported mass series and the paper core-plus-HexNAc convention. Source alpha 2,3/alpha 2,6 sialic-acid counts are retained as partial linkage annotations; predicted SNFG cartoons are not promoted to experimentally resolved isomer structures.
annotation: Source-derived composition annotations; linkage information is retained as source annotation without inferring a full topology. No complete unambiguous structures are asserted.
